security_spec.violation_condition: QEMU TCG/helper allows read-write access to the seed CSR from S/HS or U mode without first checking that the corresponding mseccfg.SSEED or mseccfg.USEED bit is 1, OR when SSEED/USEED is writable despite Zkr or the corresponding privilege mode being unimplemented (WARL violation), OR when SSEED/USEED reset values are left uninitialized exposing stale host memory to the guest
security_spec.summary: Incorrect seed CSR access-control enforcement via mseccfg.SSEED/USEED WARL fields allows unprivileged guest modes to read the emulated entropy source, breaking the Zkr security boundary
